name: Donchian Breakout Long-Only – USD/JPY (55d/4xATR)
description: Trend-following breakout strategy on USD/JPY using 55-day Donchian Channels. Enters long on close above prior bar's upper band. Fixed stop loss at 4×ATR(14) from entry via risk_unit sizing at 1% equity risk per trade. Long-only.
source:
# Donchian Breakout Long/Short – USD/JPY
# =============================================================================
# Trend-following breakout strategy on USD/JPY using 20-day Donchian Channels.
#
# RULES:
# - Long Entry:  Close > Prior bar's 20-day Donchian Upper Band
# - Short Entry: Close < Prior bar's 20-day Donchian Lower Band
# - Exit: Fixed stop loss at 2 × ATR(14) from entry (via risk_unit)
# - Sizing: 1% equity risk per trade, stop = 2 × ATR(14)
# - Both long and short sides active (reversal on opposite signal)
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 20-Day Donchian Channel (highest high / lowest low over 20 days)
donchian = donchian_channel(window=55)(src.h, src.l)
upper_band = donchian.donchian_upper
lower_band = donchian.donchian_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band >> 1
lower_band_prior = lower_band >> 1

# 14-Day ATR for volatility measurement
atr14 = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)

# Stop distance = 2 × ATR(14)
stop_dist = 4 * atr14

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# LONG ENTRY: Close breaks above prior bar's 20-day high
long_entry = close > upper_band_prior



# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long-only zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry)

# Volatility-adjusted position sizing via risk_unit (bundles sizing + fixed stop)
# Size = (Equity × 1%) / (2 × ATR(14))
# Higher ATR → wider stop → smaller position → equalized risk
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=1, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark long breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Breakout Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Upper Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Stop Distance", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, upper_band_prior, atr14, stop_dist, long_entry)
